'''August 1999 Taunton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament played on 1 August 1999 at Taunton. [[Rod Latham]] finished 1st of 9.<ref name="tourneys">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm My Tournament Reports], Rod Latham, [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001204191500/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lst12">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/lst12.htm Endor Harvest], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319195240/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/lst12.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 1 August 1999
* '''Site:''' Taunton
* '''Winner:''' [[Rod Latham]]

== Dating ==

The Light deck is dated 1 August 1999, the date of this event on Latham's results page, where he went 6–0. The Dark deck (dst12) was not preserved.
